message.reasoning: The user says: "Just trying to time a card swap right." They want to know when to swap card to ensure upcoming invoice uses new card. The policy excerpt DOC-007 says: Because the card charge happens on that date, replacing a card a day or two beforehand is enough for the new card to be used for the upcoming invoice. So answer: replace card a day or two before invoice date. Also mention that card charge happens on invoice date. So we can answer. No escalation needed.
